triples.tail_surface: must always point towards suction side of pump
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 必须始终指向泵吸入侧
triples.evidence_text: Relief valve adjusting screw cap must always point towards suction side of pump.

triples.tail_surface: remove relief valve and turn end for end
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 拆下安全阀并调转方向
triples.evidence_text: If pump rotation is reversed, remove relief valve and turn end for end.

triples.head_surface: pressure setting of pressure relief valve is to be changed
triples.tail_surface: Install a pressure gauge in discharge line
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在排出管路安装压力表
triples.evidence_text: Install a pressure gauge in discharge line for actual adjusting operation.

triples.head_surface: The temperature inside the pump will rise rapidly
triples.tail_surface: Close the discharge line at a point beyond the pressure gauge
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在压力表下游关闭排出管路
triples.evidence_text: Close the discharge line at a point beyond the pressure gauge. Limit the amount of time the pump is being operated at this condition. The temperature inside the pump will rise rapidly.

triples.head_surface: The temperature inside the pump will rise rapidly
triples.tail_surface: Limit the amount of time the pump is being operated at this condition
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 限制泵在该工况下的运行时间
triples.evidence_text: Limit the amount of time the pump is being operated at this condition. The temperature inside the pump will rise rapidly.

triples.tail_surface: located where it is accessible for inspection, maintenance, and repair
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装在便于检查、维护和修理的位置
triples.evidence_text: the pump should be located where it is accessible for inspection, maintenance, and repair.

triples.tail_surface: should be checked before starting the installation
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 安装开始前应进行检查
triples.evidence_text: port location should be checked before starting the installation.
